Generate pseudotime trajectory MetaCells (unsupervised).

# Load libraries

Load the necessary libraries.
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(dplyr)
library(destiny)
library(STEAM)
library(future)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(reshape2)
library(scales)
```


# Load data

Load Seurat object.
```{r}
lineage_cells <- readRDS("Seurat_objects/Postnatal_human_seurat_v5_GNxEarly_filtered_trajectory_lineage_cells_harmony_no_outliers.rds")
lineage_cells

head(lineage_cells[[]])
```


Check number of cells per cell type of the cluster annotation you want to create Trajectory MetaCells from.
```{r}
table(lineage_cells$cell_anno)
```


Check numbar of genes and counts:
```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.height=7}

  "NSC"  = "#FC8D62",

```


# Trajectory MetaCells

```{r}
generate_trajectory_metacells <- function(seurat.obj,
                                          rank.col = "cell_rank",
                                          window.size = 10,
                                          step.size = NULL,
                                          celltype.col = NULL) {
  # Default step size = window size
  if (is.null(step.size)) step.size <- window.size
  
  # Extract metadata
  meta <- seurat.obj@meta.data
  if (!rank.col %in% colnames(meta)) {
    stop(paste("Metadata column", rank.col, "not found in object"))
  }
  
  # Order cells only by rank.col
  meta <- meta[order(meta[[rank.col]]), , drop = FALSE]
  
  ranked.cells <- rownames(meta)
  
  # Generate window start positions
  starts <- seq(1, length(ranked.cells), by = step.size)
  
  # Create list of Seurat subsets
  window.list <- lapply(starts, function(s) {
    e <- s + window.size - 1
    cells.in.window <- ranked.cells[s:min(e, length(ranked.cells))]
    subset(seurat.obj, cells = cells.in.window)
  })
  
  # Name each element
  names(window.list) <- paste0(
    "rank_", starts,
    "_to_",
    pmin(starts + window.size - 1, length(ranked.cells))
  )
  
  return(window.list)
}

```



```{r}
window.list <- generate_trajectory_metacells(lineage_cells,
                                           rank.col = "cell_rank", # unsupervised
                                           window.size = 10,
                                           celltype.col = "cell_anno")
```



```{r}
get_assay_data <- function(se, what = c("counts", "data", "scale.data")) {
  what <- match.arg(what)
  seurat_ver <- utils::packageVersion("SeuratObject")
  
  # Determine assay
  if (seurat_ver >= "5.0.0") {
    assays_available <- SeuratObject::Assays(se)
    if ("Spatial" %in% assays_available) {
      assay <- "Spatial"
    } else if ("RNA" %in% assays_available) {
      assay <- "RNA"
    } else {
      assay <- SeuratObject::DefaultAssay(se)
    }
  } else {
    assays_available <- SeuratObject::Assays(se)
    if ("RNA" %in% assays_available) {
      assay <- "RNA"
    } else {
      assay <- SeuratObject::DefaultAssay(se)
    }
  }
  
  message("Using assay: ", assay, " | slot/layer: ", what)
  
  # Access data
  if (seurat_ver >= "5.0.0") {
    SeuratObject::GetAssayData(se, assay = assay, layer = what)
  } else {
    SeuratObject::GetAssayData(se, assay = assay, slot = what)
  }
}

```


```{r}
aggregate_trajectory_metacells <- function(window.list,
                                           anno.col = "cell_anno") {
  
  meta.list <- list()
  count.list <- list()
  
  for (i in seq_along(window.list)) {
    win <- window.list[[i]]
    
    # --- Access counts ---
    counts <- get_assay_data(win, what = "counts")
    counts <- Matrix::rowSums(counts)
    count.list[[i]] <- counts
    
    # --- Build metadata ---
    MetaCell_rank <- i
    meta <- win@meta.data
    
    if (!anno.col %in% colnames(meta)) {
      stop(paste("Column", anno.col, "not in metadata"))
    }
    
    # Aggregate annotation counts
    anno.tab <- table(meta[[anno.col]])
    anno.list <- as.list(anno.tab)
    
    # Combine metadata
    meta.list[[i]] <- c(
      list(MetaCell_rank = MetaCell_rank, MetaCell_ncells = nrow(meta)),
      anno.list
    )
  }
  
  # Determine annotation columns
  anno.cols <- unique(unlist(lapply(meta.list, function(x) setdiff(names(x), c("MetaCell_rank", "MetaCell_ncells")))))
  
  # Build metadata dataframe with consistent column order
  df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(meta.list, function(x) {
    for (a in anno.cols) {
      if (!a %in% names(x)) x[[a]] <- 0
    }
    x[c("MetaCell_rank", "MetaCell_ncells", anno.cols)]
  }))
  
  df <- as.data.frame(df)
  rownames(df) <- names(window.list)
  
  # Convert numeric-like columns to numeric
  df$MetaCell_rank <- as.numeric(df$MetaCell_rank)
  df$MetaCell_ncells <- as.numeric(df$MetaCell_ncells)
  
  for (col in anno.cols) {
    if (all(grepl("^[0-9\\.]+$", df[[col]]))) {
      df[[col]] <- as.numeric(df[[col]])
    }
  }
  
  # --- Build count matrix ---
  count.mat <- do.call(cbind, count.list)
  colnames(count.mat) <- names(window.list)
  
  # --- Create Seurat object ---
  meta.obj <- SeuratObject::CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = count.mat,
    meta.data = df
  )
  
  return(meta.obj)
}

```


```{r}
MetaCells <- aggregate_trajectory_metacells(window.list, anno.col = "cell_anno")
head(MetaCells[[]])
tail(MetaCells[[]])
```


```{r}
# Extract metadata
meta <- MetaCells[[]]

# Select relevant columns: MetaCell_rank + cell types
cell_types <- c("NSC", "INP", "NB", "YGN", "GN")
plot_df <- meta[, c("MetaCell_rank", cell_types)]

# Convert to long format
plot_long <- reshape2::melt(plot_df, id.vars = "MetaCell_rank", 
                            variable.name = "CellType", value.name = "Count")

# Optional: compute fraction instead of raw counts
plot_long$Fraction <- plot_long$Count / meta$MetaCell_ncells[plot_long$MetaCell_rank]

```


```{r}
ggplot(plot_long, aes(x = MetaCell_rank, y = Fraction, fill = CellType)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell_colors) +
  labs(x = "MetaCell rank", y = "Fraction of cells",
       title = "Cell type composition along trajectory") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))

```


Save
```{r}
saveRDS(MetaCells, file = "Seurat_objects/Postnatal_human_seurat_v5_GNxEarly_filtered_trajectory_lineage_cells_harmony_no_outliers_metacells.rds")
```


Normalize data with SCTransform.
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide', eval=T}
MetaCells_normalized <- SCTransform(MetaCells,assay = "RNA",return.only.var.genes = T)
```

MetaCells_normalized
